title: Rewrite mart_best_offers_by_gpu for the unpivoted fct_compute_offers
body:
## Parent

Part of #1 (Spec: Rewrite Downstream Marts for the Unpivoted fct_compute_offers)

## What to build

Rewrite `mart_best_offers_by_gpu` to operate on the unpivoted `fct_compute_offers` fact table at offer×tier grain. Pick the best offer per (offer_type, gpu_architecture, gpu_model_name, gpu_memory_gb, tariff tier) by that tier's `profit_usd_per_hr / number_of_gpus`, keeping only the top-ranked offer per group. Each row carries the tariff tier context (`tariff_tier_skey`, `consumer_category`, `tariff_window_type`, `tariff_block_number`) and generic per-GPU metrics (`cost_per_gpu_usd_per_hr`, `profit_per_gpu_usd_per_hr`, `cost_per_tflop_usd`, `profit_per_tflop_usd`).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The mart exposes the best offer per (offer_type, gpu_architecture, gpu_model_name, gpu_memory_gb, tariff tier) for current, available offers (verified, rentable, unrented, positive tflops/revenue/tdp)
- [ ] The best-offer selection per group is by that tier's `profit_usd_per_hr / number_of_gpus`, keeping only the top-ranked row
- [ ] Each row carries `tariff_tier_skey`, `consumer_category`, `tariff_window_type`, `tariff_block_number`, `cost_per_gpu_usd_per_hr`, `profit_per_gpu_usd_per_hr`, `cost_per_tflop_usd`, `profit_per_tflop_usd`
- [ ] A singular grain test asserts exactly 7 rows per GPU variant in the mart

## Blocked by

None — can start immediately
